representation: one record per physical page; long header node 0, continuation header node 2, airtime table node 1, footer node 3, daily totals node 4

combined_fields.lines.daypart + lines.program: Daypart (Program), space concatenation in printed order
combined_fields.totals.cash_dollars + totals.cash_spots: Cash$ - Spots, dollar amount + space-hyphen-space + spot count

exclusions.orders.pages: provenance: wrapper source_page used; isolate page local 1
exclusions.orders.flight_dates: table column schema; daily_spots keys retain each actual cell
exclusions.orders continuation null long-header fie: synthetic finalized nulls not printed on continuation pages; retain any non-null extra header value

null_conversion: printed empty header fields map to empty string; no filling missing content
number_conversion: str, preserving money/date strings and integer values
unknown_fields: preserved with extra: prefix; nested values serialized without data loss
